panels.title: Thumbs up vs. down (selected time range)
panels.description: Per-message feedback (app/golden/drilldown/pages/9_Chatbot.py's thumbs up/down, saved via app.chatbot.chat_history.save_feedback) -- the standard per-answer rating pattern, not an end-of-session survey, so a drop here can be traced to the specific messages below.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE rating = 'up') AS thumbs_up, count(*) FILTER (WHERE rating = 'down') AS thumbs_down FROM chat_message_feedback WHERE created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()

panels.title: Thumbs down rate (selected time range)
panels.description: Share of rated messages marked down -- the single number worth watching for a regression after a prompt/model change.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE rating = 'down') / greatest(count(*), 1), 1) AS down_pct FROM chat_message_feedback WHERE created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()

panels.title: Feedback volume over time
panels.description: Daily thumbs up/down counts -- a sudden drop means feedback collection itself may be broken, not necessarily that answers got better.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time, count(*) FILTER (WHERE rating = 'up') AS up, count(*) FILTER (WHERE rating = 'down') AS down FROM chat_message_feedback WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Negative feedback detail (session, question, answer, comment)
panels.description: Every thumbs-down, with the exact question/answer it was about and any comment left -- what to actually read for quality improvement, not just the aggregate rate above. session_id links back to app.chatbot.chat_history's ChatSession for full conversation context.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  f.created_at,
  cm.session_id,
  f.comment,
  (SELECT content FROM chat_messages WHERE session_id = cm.session_id AND created_at < cm.created_at AND role = 'user' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS question,
  cm.content AS answer
FROM chat_message_feedback f
JOIN chat_messages cm ON cm.id = f.message_id
WHERE f.rating = 'down' AND f.created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
ORDER BY f.created_at DESC
LIMIT 200
